Done. Here's a summary:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in production with an ~18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed the deployment history — v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy; the most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed in us-east due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and completed it successfully.
3. Verified post-rollback status: all three regions on v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api: rolled back unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 in all regions") describing the rollback. The first creation request timed out, but verification via `list_incidents` confirmed it was created — no duplicate was opened.

Note: v2.3.1 is still unhealthy and should not be redeployed until the underlying issue is investigated.
